j.brief_text: We run three independent coffee shops in Bristol. Should we launch a loyalty app, open a fourth shop in Clifton, or start selling our beans wholesale to offices? Our goal is to raise monthly profit from about £18,000 today to at least £24,000 within nine months. The loyalty app would cost about £400 a month, a fourth shop would need around £120,000 of fit-out, and wholesale would need a part-time salesperson at £1,500 a month.
